method_notes: Kingston (admissions run by Achieving for Children) uses a straight-line measurement in metres from a grid reference point within the home property supplied by Ordnance Survey (the 'seed point') to the closest named school gate set out in the school's admission arrangements, calculated by the council's GIS; only GIS distances are used. Community school arrangements: main school gate, or nearest gate where more than one (nearest pedestrian gate used by the year group). Community oversubscription order: looked-after children, siblings, exceptional need, staff children, distance. No nodal points or catchment areas. Some faith/academy schools use different end points (central point of site, specific gates) or faith/parish/designated-area criteria.

gaps: No National Offer Day 2026 (Sept 2026 entry) allocation data for Kingston could be found: the Sept 2027 entry guide (which would carry the 2026 table) was not located and the AfC/kingston.gov.uk admissions pages and the 'RBK Notes to parents following Primary 2025 allocation' PDF (rackcdn attachment 17727) failed to fetch, so 2025 is the latest year; 2023 is included as the third year. 2025 and 2024 figures are km to 3 decimals as printed in the guides (Maple 2025 '1.01 km', 2024 '1.38 km'); 2023 figures are metres from the council notes. Eight faith schools (Christ Church Surbiton, Corpus Christi, Malden Parochial, St John's, St Joseph's, St Luke's, St Matthew's, St Paul's Chessington) are listed by the council only as 'Contact the school' every year - no cut-off published; St John's own site shows a 'last child offered under proximity' series (2025: 0.624, units unstated, likely km) but it was not recorded since units/entry point were unconfirmed. PAN field = 'places available' in the 2025 allocation table; several differ from the 2026 brochure PANs (noted per school). Junior-only schools (Burlington Junior, Coombe Hill Junior, Tolworth Junior, St Andrew's and St Mark's CofE Junior) excluded as they have no Reception intake. Fern Hill 2024 cut-off 14.875 km is as printed. Postcodes from the council brochure (not cross-checked against GIAS). Per-school source_url points to the 2025-data guide; 2024/2023 values come from the other listed sources.
